metaDescription: CONNECT → UNDERSTAND → FUTURES → DECIDE → VERIFY → REMEMBER.
heroLead: Your operation leaves signals. RADR turns them into decisions that can be simulated, acted on, verified and learned from.
archLead: One supplier finding travels through Detect → Explain → Act → Control → Verify below.
flywheelLead: Every resolved finding becomes institutional knowledge.
archBoardLoop: Connect · Understand · Futures · Decide · Verify · Remember

radr.label: RADR
radr.desc: Understands what should have happened, finds the delta, quantifies value, drives action, turns fixes into controls and verifies

notClose: RADR sits across the operation as continuous operating intelligence, and turns differences into verified value.

connect.label: Connect
connect.title: Bring evidence in.
connect.copy: Operational and financial evidence enter one intelligence layer: files, exports, and integrations as they become available.

understand.label: Understand
understand.title: Normalize the operation.
understand.copy: Fragmented data becomes a common model: supplier, location, item, shift, contract, invoice, payment, channel.

detect.label: Detect
detect.title: Find the delta.
detect.copy: RADR compares what should have happened with what actually did, and surfaces the difference.

explain.label: Explain
explain.title: Show why it matters.
explain.copy: Cause, context, evidence and financial impact, attached to the finding.

act.label: Act
act.title: Drive the response.
act.copy: Give the right person the next action with evidence ready.

control.label: Control
control.title: Keep it fixed.
control.copy: Every resolution teaches RADR how the operation should behave, then becomes a persistent control.

verify.label: Verify
verify.title: Prove the value.
verify.copy: Identified is not verified. RADR checks whether the financial outcome actually materialized.

learn.label: Learn
learn.title: Compound the intelligence.
learn.copy: Resolved outcomes improve future detection, routing and controls.

learnNote: Resolved outcomes improve future detection and controls.

connect.title: Systems already in the operation
connect.statusNote: Status is honest: LIVE · EARLY ACCESS · PLANNED. No invented connectors.
